modeReason: The EU/US workplace AI-adoption survey is a non-industry story (labor, society) scoring novelty2×magnitude2×breadth3=12, well past the balance-rule threshold of 5 that applies since industry led the last three days. Several other stories (encryption fears, the DeepMind compute story, the OpenAI/Apple countersuit, the photonic chip) also independently clear the 8 threshold.
phrase: A new survey found nearly half of office workers now use AI every week. Mathematicians warn the same AI could soon make online security useless.
phraseAlternatives: Almost half of office workers now treat AI as a weekly habit. Mathematicians warn it might soon be able to crack open online security instead.
A new survey shows AI at work has become routine for millions. Some mathematicians think the same tool is getting close to breaking digital locks everywhere.
AI use at work keeps climbing toward becoming the norm. Meanwhile, mathematicians fear that same AI could soon make online security meaningless.
Nearly half of workers now reach for AI every week without a second thought. Mathematicians are having plenty of second thoughts about where that leads online.

brief.concept: Office workers now let a small AI robot share their daily desk work without a second thought, while across the room a mathematician watches a padlock crack open under the weight of that same technology.
brief.metaphor: Everyday convenience and quiet catastrophe sitting at opposite ends of the same desk.

cast.who: a human office worker sitting at a desk, typing calmly
a small round AI robot perched beside the keyboard, helping with the task
a human mathematician leaning in with a magnifying glass
a large padlock with a glowing crack spreading across its face

brief.composition: Split scene divided by a thin vertical line. Left half: a bright, ordinary office desk with the worker and the small AI robot sitting side by side, a wall calendar behind them marked '44%'. Right half: the mathematician leaning toward the oversized padlock, its crack echoing a rising line-graph shape. Keep to four main shapes total; no more text than the '44%' label.
